### Added

- (gs) [Add the Platform cluster page's Gateways tab](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3639) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Where the Platform section is turned on (`gs.features.platformSection.enabled`) and the installation has Mimir, a cluster's page has a Gateways tab: pick a gateway to see its listeners, HTTP routes and policies, or find the gateway that serves a hostname, route or policy.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.48.0...v3.49.0
